purpose: Numerical regression of existing annotations and a public interaction walkthrough with privacy-redacted original analysis rationales; not a semantic rescoring benchmark

privacy.senders: Stable anonymous labels; mapping not published
privacy.messages: Every text/media/system body replaced with a fixed placeholder
privacy.rationales: Original analysis explanations retained where generic; identifying event details, personal incidents, exact schedules and role assignments generalized. No new scoring or invented explanations.
privacy.tags: Replaced with record kind; original tags not published
privacy.dimensions: Mapped from a fixed group collaboration category allowlist
privacy.retained: Original timestamps, order, two numerical deltas and existing numerical expectations; privacy-redacted analysis explanations
privacy.omitted: Names, user IDs, contact details, attachments, URLs, local paths and source identifiers
privacy.limitations: Timestamps and numerical trajectories remain observable. Original message bodies remain hidden, so readers cannot independently verify every semantic judgment. Placeholder lengths change interaction-volume values; this fixture does not reproduce original volume or event tags.

rationale_review.alignment: Original zero-based record index + 1 matched public ID, timestamp and both deltas for all 1497 records
rationale_review.method: Every original rationale reviewed; retain interaction-specific evidence and uncertainty, generalize identifying details, keep every other sample field unchanged
